statuses.generated-current: Generated output whose producer and freshness checks pass on the current worktree.
statuses.historical-integrity: Historical evidence whose artifact bytes remain intact but which does not certify the current source tree.
statuses.historical-stale: Historical evidence with stale source bindings, paths or seals; it must not be used as current acceptance evidence.
statuses.archived: Retained for traceability only; it is not part of the executable quality system.
statuses.incomplete: Unreceipted or incomplete material retained only to avoid silent evidence loss.
